title: Student support
subtitle: Short teacher surveys become one shared plan for home and class.

noClasses.title: No classes to support yet
noClasses.body: Student support starts from a homeroom class. Once a class is assigned to you, it appears here.
noClasses.yearNote: Looking at year {{year}}. If your class is in another year, switch the year at the top of the page.

loadError.title: This page didn't load

surveys.title: Surveys
surveys.body: Each teacher and the family answer a short survey. Access codes stay valid for later months.
surveys.noEmailForSend: Add an email for this teacher before sending.
surveys.addTeacher: Add a teacher who is not on the platform

surveys.subject: Subject

codes.title: Access codes
codes.body: Share each code privately. It works on the access page and can be reused next month.

parent.title: My child's support
